answer: Each key must climb a per-key sequential delay ladder: a verifiable delay function over its public key taking T wall-clock time, unshareable across keys, so N sybils buy N ladders, not one script - piling like a glacier, grain by grain, in cores and locked stake. New identities sit in one facet of a role prism (attest, grade, submit); switching forfeits score, so puppets pay entry per band. Reputation bends like a willow but roots shallow while young: no weight-bearing stake until K epochs pass. N fakes cost N ladders plus N stakes frozen K epochs for capped yield - linear cost, flat profit.
